description: An incomplete non-ARQ C_PDU is discarded when its reception window passes, and nothing is delivered; a later segment of it starts a new reassembly.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for non-ARQ (service type tx_mode 2, no confirmation) and gets S_BIND_ACCEPTED with MTU 2048 (A-0041, A-0047). The D_PDUs are type 7 from 0.0.1.3 to 0.0.1.2, individual, address size 4, EOW 0, C_PDU ID 7, C_PDU size 15, reception window 4 (2 s); the C_PDU is as in rx-two-segments-out-of-order (U_PDU "hello there" for SAP 5). At 2000 the first segment (offset 0, 8 bytes, EOT 4) arrives: dts.reception_window 2000 ms. At its expiry, 4000, the C_PDU is discarded and nothing is delivered (C-0336, C-0532). At 6000, in a second burst, the second segment (offset 8, 7 bytes) arrives: the first is gone, so this is a new incomplete C_PDU and the timer starts again, 2000 ms; at 8000 it too is discarded. No S_UNIDATA_INDICATION is ever sent.
